subject: a cedar house on a compact floating limestone island
art_direction: 一座杉木小屋立在悬浮石岛上，短根与暖窗光精细克制，顶部浅云空阔。
visible_description: 一座杉木小屋立在悬浮石岛上，短根与暖窗光精细克制，顶部浅云空阔。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a cedar house on a compact floating limestone island. Keep the island and house in the lower two thirds, with only a few roots hanging beneath. The pitched roof and small veranda remain clearly readable. Warm window light contrasts with cool cloud reflections on the stone. The upper fifth is a smooth pale sky, with no crowded floating debris or text. Use surreal architectural landscape painting. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
